craft_notes: Sthāyin: ladder logic — ascent couplet. Rows: parallel balance (later/earlier). Rejected: moralizing higher/lower — killed: excellence, not worth. Read aloud: balanced scales.

lines: Each later rite outshines the one before;
each earlier ripens taste for what comes.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra ca uttara uttara utkṛṣṭaḥ pūrvaḥ pūrvas tadrucyartham
